articles.summary: You’re preparing for university and you finally have your reading list. There are so many books on there, and I bet you are wondering, do I have to read them all? The short answer is no. But read on to find out how to tackle and make the most out of your university reading list.
articles.title: How to Tackle Your University Reading List

articles.summary: You’ve finally finished class 12 and you are ready to take the next step toward your medical career! But now you have the dreaded NEET exam to prepare for and you don’t know where to begin. It can be an overwhelming time for any Indian student. If you are stressing about your upcoming NEET exam and need some top tips on how to prepare for them. Read on to find out more about this exam and how to ace it.
articles.title: Preparing for Exams: NEET
